project_tracker_diagnostic: Branching annual with many small heads; wedge-shaped drooping yellow rays and a globose to hemispheric disk; leaves narrow and mostly entire.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common and useful Central Texas field-learning taxon.

morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate, narrow to oblanceolate, mostly entire, often clasping or sessile.
morphology_keys.heads: Numerous small heads; rays short, often 3-lobed at the tip and drooping; disk yellow becoming more convex.
morphology_keys.phyllaries: Appressed to slightly spreading, in several series.
morphology_keys.fruit: Cypselae with small scales and often minute awns.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
